availability.note: VW AU model page lists 'MY26 Tiguan eHybrid 150TSI Elegance' as one of two grades, with MRDP footnotes for vehicles purchased from 01/10/2026 and delivered by 31/12/2026 and a 0.0% finance offer ending 31/12/2026. VW AU configurator fetch returned 403. The Beep review (updated 21 Nov 2026) confirms two grades on sale.

listPrice.note: GoAuto launch report (18 Feb 2026, VW press pricing): 'from $64,590' excluding on-road costs. CarExpert review (28 May 2026), EV Central review (30 May 2026) and Chasing Cars (20 Feb 2026, 'All prices listed are before on-road costs') agree; The Beep (updated 21 Nov 2026) still gives $64,590 before on-roads. VW AU page shows MRDP only, no amount readable.

batteryKwh.note: ADAC: Batteriekapazitaet brutto 25,7 kWh, netto 19,7 kWh for the same Tiguan 1.5 eHybrid; usable figure used. EV Central spec box labels 19.7 as net.

rangeKm.note: Australian claim 117 km for the 150TSI Elegance (CarExpert 'WLTP'; EV Central model page and The Beep agree; VW AU 'up to 117km'). Direction test: equal to the European WLTP 117 km for the 150 kW car on 255/45R19 (ADAC 345202), matching the AU Elegance's 19-inch wheels; not above it, so accepted as WLTP-derived.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 19.7 / 117 x 100. EV Central lists 13.8-14.1 kWh/100km (WLTP electric consumption) but that is a different test quantity; derived value kept for consistency with vw-tayron-phev.

combinedRangeKm.note: rangeKm 117 + 45 L tank / 5.8 L/100km x 100 (775.9) = 893. Tank 45 L from CarExpert and ADAC.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: ADAC 'Verbrauch kombiniert (WLTP) PHEV (Batterie leer)' 5,8 L/100km for the 150 kW Tiguan eHybrid on 255/45R19 (AU Elegance wheel size). Same basis as vw-tayron-phev (5.9, heavier car) and kia-sorento-phev. The Beep reports about 5 L/100km real-world with a flat battery. Held 7.0 was judged from European real-world testing.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: VW AU combined ADR 81/02 label 1.6 L/100km (FAQ), at or below 3.5.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green car = combined tailpipe CO2 120 g/km or less; CarExpert gives 37 g/km for this grade.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: VW AU '490L with rear seats in forward position', eHybrid with battery fitted (about 160 L less than petrol Tiguan, CarExpert). VDA to the cargo cover; ADAC lists the same 490 as 'normal'.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: ADAC 1486 L 'dachhoch' with rear seat folded (to the roof); CarExpert, EV Central and The Beep quote the same 1486 L. No belt-line folded figure found; kept to-roof, consistent with vw-tayron-phev.

towKg.note: CarExpert spec table braked 1800 kg; The Beep and EV Central model page agree; ADAC gives 1800 kg braked (12%) for the 150 kW car. VW AU technical spec sheet not reached.

warrantyYears.note: VW AU '5-year comprehensive warranty', transferable; CarExpert: 5 years/unlimited km, HV battery 8 years/160,000 km. Unconditional.

insuranceAnnual.note: Held value kept. Anchors: vw-tayron-phev 150TSI Elegance $1800 at $62,390 and 200TSI R-Line $2000 at $76,550 (larger body); skoda-kodiaq-phev-select $1900 at $63,490; mitsubishi-outlander-phev-aspire $1750 at $66,790.

depreciationCurve.note: VW brand convention (one curve per brand, owner rule): same curve as vw-id5 and vw-tayron-phev rows.
